purpose: Closing same-site link inventory and legal attribution

responsive.phone: Columns stack vertically; logo and link columns full width.
responsive.tablet: Top-level layout switches to a row (tablet:flex-row tablet:justify-between tablet:gap-0); logo sizes up (tablet:h-7 tablet:w-[168px]); a link column narrows to a flexed 1-unit width (tablet:w-px tablet:flex-1 tablet:order-none); bottom row switches to a row layout too (tablet:flex-row tablet:items-end tablet:justify-between).
responsive.desktop: The 'company/legal' link column widens to a fixed 40% share (desktop:w-[40%], vs. tablet's 50%); outer padding widens (desktop:px-40) with taller vertical padding (desktop:py-[54px]).
